title: Your Blink Rate Drops 60% When You Scroll
caption:
You blink 60% less every time you scroll your phone.
A cartoon insomniac grabs 'five more minutes' of scrolling, and his eyes turn into a desert - bloodshot, with a tumbleweed rolling across them.
Screen hyper-focus cuts your blink rate by 60%, so the tear film evaporates faster than it is replaced - leaving eyes dry, red and gritty. Remember to blink.
Be honest - how many hours did you scroll in bed last night?
Save this as your reminder to blink before you scroll.
